name: joplin-server
title: joplin-server
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：全程 loongarch64 构建；sqlite3 5.1.6 源码编译；Rollup 使用 wasm 别名。

缺失功能：无 sharp/sqlite-vec/PM2；向量搜索禁用；未验证桌面客户端双端同步、LDAP/SAML/Stripe/邮件。

额外依赖：需 PostgreSQL；/data 持久化（含临时 SQLite）；22300；UID 1119；APP_BASE_URL 必填。

镜像说明：3.7.21；Node 24 + PostgreSQL；sqlite3 5.1.6 源码编（临时库）；Rollup 用 wasm 别名；`/data`；22300；UID 1119；无 sharp/sqlite-vec/PM2
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: Built natively on loongarch64; sqlite3 5.1.6 is compiled from source; Rollup uses the wasm alias.

Missing features: No sharp/sqlite-vec/PM2; vector search is disabled; desktop sync, LDAP/SAML/Stripe and email are unverified.

Extra dependencies: Requires PostgreSQL; persist /data (including the temporary SQLite); port 22300; UID 1119; APP_BASE_URL is required.

Image notes: 3.7.21；Node 24 + PostgreSQL；sqlite3 5.1.6 源码编（临时库）；Rollup 用 wasm 别名；`/data`；22300；UID 1119；无 sharp/sqlite-vec/PM2

notes: PostgreSQL sidecar；/data 持久化；管理员 admin@localhost，密码在 secrets 文件；无 sharp/sqlite-vec/PM2。
未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
